text: Implemented a whole-domain scalar PE certificate using sum |c_k| sqrt(2)|e dot k_k| plus explicit floating allowance, and a separate global amplitude bound using the fixed gauge-adjusted basis. Evidence retains coefficient hash, basis/gauge/extension identity, normalization, revision, raw and inflated bounds, Jacobian margin, amplitude ceiling, and explicitly identifies a numerical inverse rather than SmoothIso. Added typed source/fixed physical domains and scalar inversion of s+d(z+e s)=0 after the rigid inverse, with the amplitude-bound bracket, safeguarded Newton/bisection, residual-mm termination, iteration counts, certificate hash, source/reverse-domain checks, and distinct bracket/exhaustion failures. Extended the shared geometry boundary so nonlinear inverse failure can propagate as a typed value; rigid/affine behavior remains exact, and PE now implements map/JVP/VJP/propose/prior/certify/inverse with workspace-owned scratch. JVM and Scala.js targeted gates: PeFieldGeometrySuite 5/5, GeometryPointOperator3Suite 4/4, MatrixFreePatchOperator3Suite 3/3 (12/12 each platform). Tests include determinant-lemma parity, hash changes, an unsafe between-sample fold missed by two positive sparse checks, oblique near-margin roundtrip, reverse/source domain failures, forced iteration exhaustion, shared-interface roundtrip, and uncertified proposal rejection. git diff --check passed.
